top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a mature, independently reproduced advance: the magic-wavelength lattice removes the trapping-light shift while interrogating many neutral atoms, bringing clocks to the 10^-18 level and enabling laboratory tests of gravitational redshift and fundamental physics. The Katori and Ye allocation is clean, with a citation scoped to the lattice clock itself. It is preferable to no award, though as a circuit-QED theorist I would have preferred a different field to lead.
